---
title: "North Carolina 2026 Election Results"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(DT)

# Load 2024 and 2026 precinct-level NCSBE results once
nc_2024 <- read_tsv("data/north_carolina/results_pct_20241105.txt", show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")
nc_2026 <- read_tsv("data/north_carolina/results_pct_20261103.txt", show_col_types = FALSE, quote = "")
```

## County Shift Map (2024 to 2026)

How counties shifted in the **2026 U.S. Senate election** (Roy Cooper vs. Michael Whatley) compared with the **2024 presidential election** (Kamala Harris vs. Donald Trump):

- **Blue arrows** = shift toward Democrats
- **Red arrows** = shift toward Republicans
- **Longer arrows** = bigger change in two-party margin

```{r}
#| label: nc-shift-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5.2
#| fig-dpi: 300

# Compute 2024 county two-party Democratic margin (US President)
margin_2024 <- nc_2024 |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US PRESIDENT", `Choice Party` %in% c("DEM", "REP")) |>
  group_by(County, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Choice Party`, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(dem_margin_2024 = 100 * (DEM - REP) / (DEM + REP)) |>
  select(County, dem_margin_2024)

# Compute 2026 county two-party Democratic margin (US Senate)
margin_2026 <- nc_2026 |>
  filter(`Contest Name` == "US SENATE", `Choice Party` %in% c("DEM", "REP")) |>
  group_by(County, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Choice Party`, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(dem_margin_2026 = 100 * (DEM - REP) / (DEM + REP)) |>
  select(County, dem_margin_2026)

# Load NC county polygons and calculate centroids for arrow origins
nc_counties <- st_as_sf(maps::map("county", "north carolina", plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE)) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  mutate(County = str_to_upper(str_remove(ID, "^north carolina,"))) |>
  left_join(margin_2024, by = "County") |>
  left_join(margin_2026, by = "County") |>
  mutate(
    shift = dem_margin_2026 - dem_margin_2024,
    direction = factor(
      if_else(shift >= 0, "Shift toward Democrats", "Shift toward Republicans"),
      levels = c("Shift toward Democrats", "Shift toward Republicans")
    )
  )

centroids <- nc_counties |>
  st_centroid() |>
  mutate(
    lon = st_coordinates(geom)[, 1],
    lat = st_coordinates(geom)[, 2],
    scale_k = 0.016,
    lon_end = lon + if_else(shift >= 0, -abs(shift) * scale_k, abs(shift) * scale_k),
    lat_end = lat + abs(shift) * scale_k * 0.65
  ) |>
  st_drop_geometry()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = nc_counties, fill = "#f3f4f6", color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_segment(
    data = centroids,
    aes(
      x = lon,
      y = lat,
      xend = lon_end,
      yend = lat_end,
      color = direction
    ),
    linewidth = 0.75,
    alpha = 0.9,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.14, "cm"), type = "closed"),
    show.legend = TRUE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Shift toward Democrats" = "#1d68c4",
      "Shift toward Republicans" = "#d73027"
    ),
    drop = FALSE,
    name = NULL
  ) +
  coord_sf(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Shift in Margin from 2024 President to 2026 U.S. Senate",
    subtitle = "Each arrow starts at a county's center; longer arrows indicate a larger shift in two-party margin",
    caption = "Source: North Carolina State Board of Elections (NCSBE)"
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15, margin = margin(b = 4)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#4b5563", size = 10.5, margin = margin(b = 10)),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#6b7280", size = 9, margin = margin(t = 8)),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10.5),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 10, 15)
  )
```

## Closest Precincts Map

Which voting precincts had the smallest margins of victory in the **2026 U.S. Senate race**? Out of 2,626 real precincts across North Carolina, **two ended in an exact tie** and **two more were decided by a single vote**. Hover or click any precinct marker (or zoom in to see exact precinct boundaries) to inspect the vote totals.

```{r}
#| label: closest-precincts-map
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Read official 2026 NCSBE voting precinct boundaries directly from zip
precincts_sf <- st_read(
  "/vsizip/data/north_carolina/SBE_PRECINCTS_20260824.zip/SBE_PRECINCTS_20260824.shp",
  quiet = TRUE
)

# Calculate two-party margin for every real precinct in 2026 US Senate and rank them
precinct_margins <- nc_2026 |>
  filter(
    `Contest Name` == "US SENATE",
    `Real Precinct` == "Y",
    `Choice Party` %in% c("DEM", "REP")
  ) |>
  group_by(County, Precinct, `Choice Party`) |>
  summarise(votes = sum(`Total Votes`), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = `Choice Party`, values_from = votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  filter(DEM + REP > 0) |>
  mutate(
    total_two_party = DEM + REP,
    vote_diff = abs(DEM - REP),
    pct_margin = 100 * vote_diff / total_two_party,
    winner = factor(
      case_when(
        DEM == REP ~ "Exact Tie",
        DEM > REP ~ "Roy Cooper (DEM)",
        TRUE ~ "Michael Whatley (REP)"
      ),
      levels = c("Exact Tie", "Roy Cooper (DEM)", "Michael Whatley (REP)")
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(pct_margin, vote_diff, desc(total_two_party)) |>
  mutate(rank = min_rank(pct_margin))

# Join top 50 closest precincts to polygons and transform to WGS84 (EPSG:4326) for Leaflet
top50_polys <- precincts_sf |>
  inner_join(
    precinct_margins |> slice_head(n = 50),
    by = c("county_nam" = "County", "prec_id" = "Precinct")
  ) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  arrange(pct_margin, vote_diff, desc(total_two_party)) |>
  mutate(
    precinct_label = if_else(
      enr_desc == prec_id,
      prec_id,
      paste0(prec_id, " — ", str_to_title(enr_desc))
    ),
    popup_html = paste0(
      "<strong>Rank #", rank, ": ", str_to_title(county_nam), " County</strong><br>",
      "Precinct: ", precinct_label, "<br><hr style='margin:4px 0;'>",
      "Roy Cooper (DEM): <strong>", scales::comma(DEM), "</strong><br>",
      "Michael Whatley (REP): <strong>", scales::comma(REP), "</strong><br>",
      "Margin: <strong>", vote_diff, if_else(vote_diff == 1, " vote", " votes"),
      sprintf(" (%.2f%%)", pct_margin), "</strong> — ", winner
    ),
    hover_label = paste0(
      "#", rank, " ", str_to_title(county_nam), " (", prec_id, "): ",
      if_else(vote_diff == 0, "Exact Tie!", paste0(winner, " +", vote_diff, " (", sprintf("%.2f%%", pct_margin), ")"))
    )
  )

top50_points <- top50_polys |>
  st_centroid()

winner_pal <- colorFactor(
  palette = c("#7c3aed", "#1d68c4", "#d73027"),
  levels = c("Exact Tie", "Roy Cooper (DEM)", "Michael Whatley (REP)")
)

leaflet(height = "520px") |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) |>
  addPolygons(
    data = top50_polys,
    fillColor = ~winner_pal(winner),
    fillOpacity = 0.35,
    color = ~winner_pal(winner),
    weight = 2,
    popup = ~popup_html,
    label = ~hover_label
  ) |>
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = top50_points,
    radius = ~if_else(rank <= 10, 8, 6),
    fillColor = ~winner_pal(winner),
    fillOpacity = 0.9,
    color = "#ffffff",
    weight = 1.8,
    popup = ~popup_html,
    label = ~hover_label
  ) |>
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    pal = winner_pal,
    values = top50_polys$winner,
    title = "50 Closest Precincts",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

### Closest Precincts Ranked

```{r}
#| label: closest-precincts-table
#| echo: false

precinct_margins |>
  slice_head(n = 100) |>
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(precincts_sf) |> select(county_nam, prec_id, enr_desc),
    by = c("County" = "county_nam", "Precinct" = "prec_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Precinct = if_else(
      is.na(enr_desc) | enr_desc == Precinct,
      Precinct,
      paste0(Precinct, " (", str_to_title(enr_desc), ")")
    ),
    `% Margin` = sprintf("%.2f%%", pct_margin)
  ) |>
  select(
    Rank = rank,
    County,
    Precinct,
    `Cooper (DEM)` = DEM,
    `Whatley (REP)` = REP,
    `Vote Diff` = vote_diff,
    `% Margin`,
    Outcome = winner
  ) |>
  datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    options = list(pageLength = 10, autoWidth = TRUE)
  )
```
